problem: helix-cli has working playbook CLI commands (hlx playbook check, hlx playbook checks) but the SKILL.md frontmatter and documentation do not mention playbook at all. MCP clients using the hlx-cli skill have no visibility into playbook commands. The commands table in SKILL.md lists 9 command groups but omits 'playbook'. Additionally, the CLI only supports check-related operations (trigger check, list checks) — it has no commands for rule CRUD (create, list, get, update, delete rules).

Trigger and poll compliance check (113 lines): POST /api/playbook/rules/{ruleId}/check then poll GET .../checks/{checkId} every 5s for up to 10 minutes. Shows async polling model with TERMINAL_STATUSES (PASS, FAIL, ERROR).
List check history: GET /api/playbook/rules/{ruleId}/checks. Simple list command.
Skill documentation for AI agents. Frontmatter description lists triggers but omits 'playbook'. Commands table (line 36-47) lists 9 groups, no playbook entry. Workflow section has no playbook step.
Main CLI router (170 lines). Line 17 imports runPlaybook, lines 133-137 route 'playbook' command. Already integrated but undocumented.
hxFetch client (134 lines) with retry, auth headers (X-API-Key or Bearer), basePath. Playbook commands use basePath: '/api'. Shows API call pattern.
